name: wp-desktop-mode
description: WordPress admin as a desktop OS — draggable, resizable windows on a desktop with a dock.

scripts.build: npm run vendor:pixi && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:iframe-bridge && npm run build:recycle-bin
scripts.build:desktop: vite build --mode development && vite build --mode production
scripts.build:iframe-bridge: WPDM_TARGET=iframe-bridge vite build --mode development && WPDM_TARGET=iframe-bridge vite build --mode production
scripts.build:recycle-bin: WPDM_TARGET=recycle-bin vite build --mode development && WPDM_TARGET=recycle-bin vite build --mode production
scripts.check:plugin: wp-env run cli wp plugin check desktop-mode
